verdict.rationale: Linear supports asynchronous team collaboration via comments on issues, documents, and images (linear-docs-24, linear-docs-22) and @mentions (linear-docs-54), plus Slack integration for notifications (linear-docs-61, linear-docs-81), but there is no evidence of a native real-time chat/messaging feature inside Linear itself — collaboration is comment-based, not conversational chat. missing for 10: a dedicated in-app chat/messaging surface, evidence of synchronous team chat, and any first-party claim positioning Linear as a chat tool rather than relying on comments/Slack.
